prompts.GlassA: Use case: stylized-concept. Production layered pixel-art sprites for LOSTSTAR's miniature cosmic lost-property museum. Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE only: fine precise purple/bronze pixel art, warm lamps, cyan glass highlights. Create a NEW TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas, exactly 2 columns x 2 rows, four equal SQUARE cells, no background and no text. TWO distinct empty display vessels: LEFT column a tall graceful brass bell-glass cloche for a paper receipt, RIGHT column a squat cylindrical screw-top apothecary glass jar with copper base for a tape roll. TOP ROW: BACK LAYER of each vessel, with rear glass wall (very transparent), rear metal rim and interior floor shadows, leave front wall absent so a separate item can be inserted. BOTTOM ROW: matching FRONT OVERLAY of the exact same vessel, only front curved-glass edge highlights, thin semitransparent pane, front half of base and blank small metal nameplate. The center must stay transparent, no solid fill. The bottom overlay is NOT a second complete jar; it is the front half cutaway layer registered pixel-exactly to the top counterpart. Same view/camera, scale and center x and floor baseline in both rows. Each cell has 12% transparent padding. Refined 2.5D miniature glass volume, irregular crisp pixel specular strokes, no blur, restrained highlights. No items, no characters, no labels, no UI panels, no floor outside the little base. Keep alpha transparency inside empty glass.
prompts.GlassB: Use case: stylized-concept. Production layered pixel-art sprites for LOSTSTAR's miniature cosmic lost-property museum. The input picture is only a STYLE REFERENCE for fine crisp purple/bronze pixel art and warm lamps. Make a NEW TRANSPARENT PNG atlas with exactly 2 columns and 2 rows of equal square cells, no background, no lettering. TWO empty exhibition enclosures: LEFT column a broad hexagonal glass terrarium showcase on a low stepped walnut/brass plinth for a nested parcel, RIGHT column a narrow cylindrical vacuum chamber with a small domed brass lid and cyan glass for a time stamp. TOP ROW shows each enclosure's BACK HALF: rear rim, very faint translucent back glass, inner floor and rear legs, FRONT WALL ABSENT for inserting animated items. BOTTOM ROW shows only its corresponding FRONT OVERLAY: front glass-edge reflections, nearly transparent pane, front rim/base lip, and a tiny blank nameplate. Same exact camera, geometry, size, centered registration and floor baseline as matching top cell. Do NOT draw an entire duplicate enclosure in the bottom row. Centers and surrounding canvas must remain transparent. Refined high-density pixel clusters and subtle 2.5D material depth, no antialiased vector lines, no blur. Empty vessels only, no item, no creature, no text, no ground plane outside plinth. At least 12 percent transparent padding per cell.
prompts.GlassC: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new TRANSPARENT production pixel-art atlas of two sophisticated EMPTY glass display containers for the LOSTSTAR cosmic postal museum, matching the reference image's detailed warm brass, midnight purple and cyan reflections. Exactly 2 columns x 2 rows of equal SQUARE cells. LEFT column: tall sci-fi sealed glass preservation capsule with copper clasps, rounded window and a dark purple but very transparent inner back wall for a cosmic parcel. RIGHT column: elegant low round glass dome on an ornate brass pedestal, suited to a tiny signing bell. TOP ROW: back half of each container with rear frame, rear very transparent glass and interior floor, leave the front completely open. BOTTOM ROW: front-half overlay registered to the top: bright edge reflections, almost-transparent front pane, front half of pedestal rim and a blank separate small brass plaque. The bottom parts must have large transparent centers, not complete duplicate containers. Align identical scale, center and floor baseline between top and bottom cells. Crisp high-resolution pixel art, 2.5D miniature perspective, rich metal patina and believable curved glass, restrained highlights. No objects inside, no text, no characters, no checkerboard or opaque background. Generous transparent padding, consistent lighting upper left.
prompts.Room: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW refined high-density pixel-art ROOM BACKGROUND for LOSTSTAR's lost-property museum. Input is only a style/palette reference: warm mysterious cosmic postal observatory, brass, walnut, violet-blue stone, delicate pixel lamps. Portrait 4:5 illustration, slight elevated front 2.5D dollhouse view, legible geometry rather than a flat poster. A beautiful vaulted room with a dark star window in the upper left, copper pipes, muted teal instruments and warm suspended lamps. IMPORTANT: the room contains exactly SIX EMPTY low display plinths arranged in two orderly rows of three, with ample OPEN AIR above each. Rear row centered at roughly x=21%,50%,79%, y=43%; front row at x=21%,50%,79%, y=70%. Plinth tops roughly 17% of room width, shallow rectangular/isometric brass and walnut bases with empty dark circular display pads. Do NOT draw glass jars, domes, artifacts or creatures on them: separate animated production layers will be placed there. Keep the entire area above each plinth clear, no foreground furniture masking the six sites. Floor extends to bottom, floor has subtle purple stone tiles with warm light, a tiny unobtrusive docking alcove at far left edge but no ship, no robot, no person. Very detailed coherent pixel textures with crisp edges; not low-poly or blurry painting, no gradients pretending pixel art. No words, no logo, no UI borders, no labels or text anywhere. Maintain comfortable contrast and a welcoming, eccentric museum atmosphere.
